messages:
Dana: Heads-up: staging promo blocked. Several jobs failed extracting uploaded layers (unexpected EOF). DeployBot paused the promotion.

DeployBot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot at 3433334444. Reason: multipart-upload-truncated on service-web-staging. See https://ci.redwood/builds/12567 :no_entry_sign:

Rohan: Logs show Content-Length mismatch on GET for layer chunk. Looks like a partial object served from edge cache.

Dana: Change window closes in ~35m. Options: pin to last-good digest, retry uploads with new cache key, or force cache purge. Pin is fastest.

Rohan: I can trigger a reupload with `CHUNK_SIZE=8MB` and `VALIDATE_UPLOAD=1` and add commit SHA to key. Start that in background if we pin.

opsoncall: If we pin, document rollback steps and add alert for `image.unpack.errors`. Also ensure two approvals for manual promote.

CI-Runner-Bot: queued `/ci retry builds/12567 --scope=image-unpack` (3 runners).

Dana: Manual promote API: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=service-web --digest=sha256:lastgood --reason="pin to known-good to meet change window"` (requires 2 approvals).

Rohan: +1 to pin, will reupload and validate.

opsoncall: +1

DeployBot: Promote executed: service-web (staging) -> sha256:lastgood at 3433334518. Comment: pinned to known-good digest to unblock release window.

Rohan: Reupload done, validation passed. I'll retarget canary after a short smoke (T+10m) and file ST-1510 with storage team for cache node investigation.

storage-bot: Storage ticket ST-1510 created and assigned. Observability showed increased 5xxs from an edge node around the time of failure.

Dana: Unblock confirmed. Owners for postmortem: Rohan (artifact uploader), storage-team (edge cache). I'll add release note: "Temporary pin to last-good image due to truncated multipart uploads; retarget planned after verified reupload."

Rohan: Follow-ups: add `VALIDATE_UPLOAD=1` to CI push, add upload healthcheck, and include cache-key suffix on uploads. Filing a short postmortem after cut. :thumbsup:
